Basic Skill Tree... #

Most skills are learned by using a skill items, such as an Orb or Book. However, some skills are bound to items or learned from completing quests!

Select a Skill from the Skill Tree to preview the details of it.

Combo
Create powerful damage by consecutivly using a specific set of skills. All three skills must be consecutive and connect within 2 seconds of each attack.
  • Comb Skill
    • 1st Skill:
      • Weapon Skill
    • 2nd Skill:
      • Twisting Slash
      • Rageful Blow
      • Death Stab
      • Strike of Destruction
      • Blood Storm
      • Fire Blow
    • 3rd Skill:
      • Twisting Slash
      • Rageful Blow
      • Death Stab
      • Strike of Destruction
      • Blood Storm
      • Fire Blow
  • ATK Skill
    • Skill DMG: inherits the Skill DMG of the last skill used in the Combo.
    • Skill DMG +1.5 per STR Level
    • Skill DMG +1 per AGI Level
    • Skill DMG +1 per ENE Level
    • Range: 3

Strong Blessing
Increases Party Member’s ATK/WIZ/Curse and absorbs Party Member’s HP and takes DMG in their place.

  • AG cost: 20
  • Non-element
